mapper.select: SELECT t.tdm11_task_relate_rule_id AS task_relate_rule_id , t.tdm11_task_id AS task_id , t.tdm11_relate_type AS relate_type , f_cdnm('Ruletype', tdm11_relate_type, tdm11_company_id, f_today()) AS relate_type_name , t.tdm11_rule_cd AS rule_code , t.tdm11_rule_nm AS rule_name , t.tdm11_close_date::date AS close_date FROM ( SELECT tdm11_task_relate_rule.* , law_nm AS tdm11_rule_nm , close_date AS tdm11_close_date FROM tdm11_task_relate_rule INNER JOIN ( SELECT sys09_code law_cd , sys09_name law_nm , sys09_close_date close_date FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'TdmLawCode' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) law ON law_cd = tdm11_rule_cd WHERE tdm11_task_id = #{taskId} AND tdm11_relate_type = '1' UNION ALL SELECT tdm11_task_relate_rule.* , COALESCE(bbs15_title,'**연결끊김. "1345 회사규정(관리자)" 화면에서 확인해주세요') AS tdm11_rule_nm , bbs15_close_date AS tdm11_close_date FROM tdm11_task_relate_rule LEFT JOIN getCompanyRule(#{companyId}, null) ON bbs15_company_rule_cd = tdm11_rule_cd WHERE tdm11_task_id = #{taskId} AND tdm11_relate_type = '2' ) t WHERE tdm11_relate_type LIKE #{relateType} AND CONCAT(tdm11_rule_nm, tdm11_rule_cd) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm11_relate_type, tdm11_rule_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm11_task_relate_rule (tdm11_task_relate_rule_id, tdm11_company_id, tdm11_task_id, tdm11_relate_type, tdm11_rule_cd, tdm11_upd_nm, tdm11_upd_date) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{taskId}, #{relateType}, #{ruleCode}, #{updName}, f_sysdate())
